text: When SuppressSourceGeneration = true, must generator-only diagnostics MsgPack011, MsgPack016, and MsgPack017 still be reported?
options: Only runtime-contract diagnostics are required; omit MsgPack011/016/017 as the README describes.
Report every applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostic, including MsgPack011/016/017, just as in version 3.1.0.
why_it_matters: The first answer makes the README's diagnostic carve-out compliant; the second makes that carve-out a requirement violation and requires preserving those additional analyzer paths for suppressed types.
